basis: Kennametal’s May 7 earnings release was the earliest qualifying public disclosure found. For fiscal Q3 ended March 31, 2025, it reported consolidated sales of $486,399,000 against $515,794,000 a year earlier, a 5.70% decline. The 95% cutoff was $490,004,300. February’s guidance midpoint of $490,000,000 was just $4,300 below that cutoff, but the $500,000,000 high end exceeded it.

coverage.detail: The original fiscal Q3 2024 release reported sales of $515,794,000. That equals the prior-year comparative in the fiscal Q3 2025 release, so the reported base requires no adjustment.

November 6, 2024, preceding earnings cycle. The $480 million to $500 million quarterly outlook explicitly covered fiscal Q2, the December quarter. The $2.0 billion to $2.1 billion outlook covered the full fiscal year.
January 14, 2025. The restructuring announcement quantified approximately $15 million in annualized pre-tax savings and gave no March-quarter sales forecast.

February 5 Q2 earnings release. Management explicitly forecast fiscal Q3 sales of $480 million to $500 million, including an estimated 3% currency headwind. The high end exceeded the cutoff by $9,995,700. The reduced $1.950 billion to $2.000 billion forecast covered the full year.
February 5 earnings call. Slide 10 and the CFO’s public remarks both gave the same $480 million to $500 million Q3 sales range. The slide’s separate decline of 2% to 6% referred to volume.
The February 14 Form 8-K disclosed an executive separation agreement without a Q3 sales update.
The Barclays conference notice identified February 19 attendees and gave no Q3 sales figures.
Kennametal’s February 20 announcement identified the March 11 Loop Capital conference and gave no Q3 sales figures.
The February 21 notice announced management attendance at the March 12 J.P. Morgan conference and gave no Q3 sales figures.

Kennametal’s public webcast and presentation archive lists the February 5 and May 7 earnings calls consecutively. Searches for public remarks, conference materials and preliminary results found no intervening issuer communication narrowing the Q3 sales range.
April 16. Kennametal scheduled the Q3 release for before market open on May 7 and the call for 9:30 a.m. ET. The scheduling notice contained no preliminary results.
The April 30 Form 8-K announced a $0.20 quarterly dividend without a sales update.
The May 1 exhibit announced Shelley Bausch’s election to the board without a sales update.

May 7 actuals. The earnings release’s consolidated sales table gives 486,399 and 515,794, in thousands of dollars, for the three months ended March 31, 2025 and 2024. The separately disclosed 3% organic decline excludes the currency effect.
Kennametal’s original wire distribution timestamps the earnings release May 7, 2025 at 6:30 a.m. ET, before the earnings call.

publication_date_evidence: Kennametal dated its immediate-release Exhibit 99.1 May 7, 2025. Its original wire distribution confirms publication at 6:30 a.m. ET that day.
